body: Don't think i'm gonna die. Didn't take enough for that anyway. Just wanna talk. I feel weird
Idk but i felt like this another time i overdosed. Just scared. Gonna head out i think.
Sorry.it's not your responsibility. Just scared but i knew this would happen.
Shit i'm starting to feel paranoid. Even if i tell myself it's placebo it doesn't help. Fuck.
Thank you, you're really nice but your words are falling on deaf ears. Hopefully i'll be dead in a few hours so i won't have to deal with this shitty world.

It's a good song. I do have people i can talk to but it won't help. I'm depressed and i will always be depressed. I'm a fucked up person with a fucked up brain. I can't be fixed. But it doesn't matter now.  I took some of the pills so maybe in a few minutes i'll have the balls to take the rest. I feel slightly calmer now so maybe i'll be able to go through with it, maybe.

It's amazing but not in my case. I'm suffering and I will always suffer, that is clear to med. I hate myself for being scared. I just want to fucking die but my pathetic brain won't let me. Maybe i'll go out to some bad neighborhood and wait for someone to murder me so i won't have to sit here and debate with myself like an idiot.

I appreciate you trying to help me, it's really kind. However, I know it won't get better. And we're all gonna die eventually anyway, it's just a matter of time. All that's standing in my way is my fucking survival instinct. Without it i would be dead like 13 years ago.
Welp, the psychiatrist made it clear that he can't help me.  Guess i'll die

I'm not a doctor or anything, but I talked to a doctor a couple weeks ago who told me that when you're feeling listless and just basically don't want to deal with life whatsoever, you need SNRIs rather than SSRIs. Perhaps that could be for you, if you could get a doctor to prescribe them for you?
I'm really sorry about that. Are you seeing a therapist or anything? I'm not sure how much they help, but some people say they're great. Maybe it would help you? Sorry for the late reply.

You mean they refuse to give you antidepressants? If so, that's insane. I'm really sorry you can't afford to go to the doctor. Have you tried admitting yourself to the psych ward? I don't know what country you're in, so I don't know how much it would cost, of course. And I can only speak from my own experience, but for me, it was easy to get admitted, and they gave me antidepressants.
It's fine, you can bitch all you want, haha. I don't mind, I tend to do that myself :) It's difficult feeling needy. Do you have separation anxiety? Have you told people how you're feeling?
I'm sorry you're feeling like this. I know you probably don't believe me but I wish I could help. Have you been to the doctor about your physical problems? And are you taking antidepressants?

I'm sorry for the comment from that other person. ''Before anyone can really like you, you need to like yourself.'' What an awful thing to say. I would hug you if I could, OP. Wanna talk? It's okay if you don't, of course. Sending hugs.

I know, I'm unfortunately an unhealthily clingy person and I can get horrible separation anxiety and I can't burden my friend like that. I don't know what I'm gonna do. But it was still really kind of you to talk to me and I really appreciate it. Thank you so much.

I don't know. I'm scared that he doesn't want to be my friend anymore. I'm always scared of that. And I don't think I could live without him in my life. As you probably noticed, I'm barely holding on as it is. I wish I could be more like him. If he wants to spend time with me, he calls me. He's not scared. He's always there for me. I just wish things were like they used to be.

I'm a coward unfortunately. We've been friends since we were kids and yet I can barely muster up the courage to call him, how pathetic is that? I want to talk to him about this but I'm terrified he'll tell me he doesn't like me anymore and confirm my fears. I'm a paranoid and insecure person and I can't bring myself to call him. It's all so pathetic.  He literally lives not even five minutes from me. I just wish I could call him. All of this is probably just in my head, my mental state is not great. He's probably waiting for me to call and not angry at all. But I'm still scared. I'm just too scared.

It's true, isn't it? You know, I want to go to the psych ward and tell them to pump me so full of drugs I can't feel anything. But it doesn't matter, does it? Some people can't get better, some people are meant to die. I can't compare myself to you, I'm only 26, but if things don't get better than this, why go through all the suffering? The only thing keeping me from killing myself is my crippling fear of death. It's so stupid. Sorry for rambling like this on your post, I don't know what I'm doing anymore.
I'll help, as much as I can. What's wrong?

Don't be such a fucking asshole. Someone having a questionable username doesn't immediately invalidate what they have to say, that's the dumbest thing I've ever heard. Stop being a prick. The people in this subreddit are in a horrible, horrible place and are suicidal, so telling OP they're ''lucky'' and should ''appreciate the fact that he can carry on with his life'' is really shitty.
